title: Cloud App Control and SSL inspection: what CAC can see

domain-level-only-when-not-decrypted.statement: For traffic that is not decrypted, including destinations covered by the one-click options, Cloud App Control can use only the domain-level information from the first pass (CONNECT host or SNI), so it has less to identify the application with than for decrypted traffic.
domain-level-only-when-not-decrypted.conditions: Derived from the pipeline claims plus the one-click claims. No source states how CAC identifies applications, so how much less visibility matters per application is unverified (see zia.cloud-app-control.rule-criteria:app-identity).
